$description: Design tokens for the OSM Navigation product (owner: ux-designer). Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft ($type/$value). Two modes: 'light' (day) and 'night'. UI colours follow Material 3 roles; map colours are complete Protomaps basemap 'Flavor' objects (@protomaps/basemaps styles, schema 4.x tiles at commit 42ffaaa4) plus a small 'custom' group applied by post-processing (see docs/design/map-style.md). This file is the single source of truth: if docs/design/map-style.md or a screen spec quotes a different value, this file wins.

modes.light: Day mode («өдрийн горим» / Day mode). Default on first visit (NAV-002 AC 26).
modes.night: Night mode («шөнийн горим» / Night mode). Glare-free: no large area lighter than #3A4452, text never pure white.

meta.contrastTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 for UI text, 3:1 for icons, focus rings and control boundaries. Every text/background pair listed in 'contrastPairs' is checked by docs/design/prototypes/check-contrast.mjs.

on-surface.$description: Primary text and icons on surface

on-surface-variant.$description: Secondary text, attribution text, inactive icons

outline.$description: Control boundaries (3:1 against the map earth colour)

primary.$description: Active / following state, text buttons, links on hover

primary-container.$description: Background of the my-location button in the following state

inverse-surface.$description: Material 3 role, kept for completeness. NAV-002 messages and tooltips use message-surface instead (glare rule at night)

disabled-content.$description: Disabled icons (zoom at limit, unsupported location). Exempt from contrast (WCAG 1.4.11 inactive components)

message-surface.$description: Offline banner and location messages. Day: Material 3 inverse surface (snackbar)

message-outline.$description: 1px border; same as the surface in day (invisible)

stale-dot.$description: NAV-002 AC 23: last known position after fixes stop

stale-ring.$description: NAV-005 AC 76 (Android browse map only): ring of the hollow stale dot, the non-colour stale cue (map-style.md §7.8). Darker than stale-dot so the ring keeps >= 3:1 on earth, buildings and parks. The web dot does not use it (D175)

fill.$description: NAV-003 selected-place / selected-point pin body (map-style.md §7.1). >= 3:1 on earth and on major roads

center.$description: Inner dot of the pin head

selected.$description: NAV-004 selected route line fill (map-style.md §7.2). >= 3:1 on earth, major and minor roads and trunk (AC 16)

selected-casing.$description: 2px edge each side of the selected line; keeps the line readable on white roads and on the blue location dot

alternative.$description: NAV-004 alternative route line fill: a different token from 'selected' and a muted blue-grey, so it reads as secondary (AC 16)

alternative-casing.$description: 1px edge each side of an alternative line, >= 3:1 on earth and major roads

origin-fill.$description: NAV-004 origin marker centre (used when the start is not «Миний байршил»)

step-fill.$description: NAV-004 manoeuvre point shown after a turn-list row is activated (AC 30)

banner.$description: NAV-005 guidance banner background, manoeuvre and arrival variants (navigation-ux.md §2.3). Green marks active guidance, as in Google Maps; distinct from the blue route preview

on-banner.$description: Banner icon, distance and instruction text; also text on banner-then and banner-reroute

on-banner-variant.$description: Street name line, frozen (GPS lost) distance

banner-outline.$description: 1dp banner border; equals the banner in day (invisible)

banner-then.$description: Then strip («Дараа нь») under the banner; later also the NAV-013 lane strip

banner-reroute.$description: Recalculating (off-route) banner: neutral grey, not an error colour (navigation-ux.md §2.3)

on-banner-reroute-variant.$description: Secondary line of the recalculating banner (reroute failure reason)

puck-fill.$description: Navigation puck (chevron) fill, map-style.md §7.4; same blue as the location dot

puck-stroke.$description: 3dp puck ring; separates the puck from the blue route line

puck-outline.$description: 1dp hairline outside the puck ring, so the white ring also reads on light map areas and on the dimmed old route while off-route

puck-stale-fill.$description: Puck while GPS is lost (AC 51), same grey as the stale location dot

badge.$description: NAV-017 «Туршилтын горим» badge background (W1, AC 14): a light amber pill that reads as 'test', distinct from the green guidance banner, the blue route and the red pin, and not an error colour

badge-outline.$description: 1px badge border, >= 3:1 on the map earth so the pill shape reads on a light map

other.$description: Paths, footways, tracks (kind=path). Darker than earth so footways are visible at z14+

trunk.$description: Fill for kind=major_road with kind_detail trunk/trunk_link (post-processing, map-style.md §3.2)

lowzoom_highway.$description: Road fill below z10, when Protomaps draws no casing: intercity roads must stay visible at country zooms (map-style.md §3.3)

error-container.$description: Darker than Material 3 (#8C1D18) to limit glare at night

message-surface.$description: Night deviates from Material 3 inverse surface on purpose: a light snackbar on the night map is glare. Raised dark surface + outline instead

message-outline.$description: 1px border separates the message from the dark map

stale-ring.$description: Night ring of the hollow stale dot (Android browse map, map-style.md §7.8). 4dp ring only, so no glare; >= 3:1 on earth, buildings, parks and major roads

fill.$description: Lighter red so the pin reads on the dark map; small area, so no glare. >= 3:1 on earth and on major roads

stroke.$description: Dark outline at night (a white ring would glare)

selected.$description: Night selected route line fill. >= 3:1 on night earth and major roads (AC 16); thin line, so no glare

selected-casing.$description: Dark edge (same as the night road casings): separates the line from trunk/motorway fills, where the fill alone is < 3:1

alternative-casing.$description: Dark 1px edge of an alternative line

origin-fill.$description: Night origin marker centre (dark, a white disc would glare)

banner.$description: Night guidance banner: dark green, no glare

on-banner.$description: Night banner text and icon (never pure white)

on-banner-variant.$description: Night street name line, frozen distance

banner-outline.$description: 1dp border that separates the dark banner from the dark map

banner-reroute.$description: Night recalculating banner (same as the night message surface)

on-banner-reroute-variant.$description: Night secondary line of the recalculating banner

puck-fill.$description: Night puck fill: light chevron with a dark ring, because the night route line is light blue (a blue puck would vanish on it). 40dp, the only bright element

puck-stroke.$description: Night puck ring (dark, like the night route casing)

puck-outline.$description: Night 1dp hairline (same as the ring at night)

puck-stale-fill.$description: Night puck while GPS is lost

badge.$description: Night badge background: dark amber, no glare (small pill on the dark map)

on-badge.$description: Night badge text and icon (not pure white)

badge-outline.$description: Night 1px badge border, >= 3:1 on the night earth

lowzoom_highway.$description: Night: same as the normal fill (already lighter than earth)

ui.$description: System stack, every member has Cyrillic incl. Ө/Ү. No web-font download (NAV-002 AC 46: no requests to font CDNs).

map.$description: MapLibre glyph fontstacks, bundled PBF glyphs (map-style.md §5)

caption.$description: Attribution, scale bar, tooltips (12/16). Never below 11 CSS px (NAV-002 AC 34)

body-large.$description: NAV-003 search input text, result name, nearest-place name (16/24). 16px also stops mobile browsers zooming into the input. NAV-004: route fields, turn-list instruction text

title-large.$description: NAV-004 route summary duration, e.g. «12 мин» (22/28, Material 3 title-large). The one number a user looks for first. NAV-005: «Хүрэх цаг» line of the trip progress panel

nav-distance.$description: NAV-005 banner distance to the next manoeuvre, e.g. «300 м» (32/40; on Android 1rem = 16sp). Font scale capped at 1.2 (navigation-ux.md §2.5). Tabular figures

nav-instruction.$description: NAV-005 banner instruction, e.g. «Баруун тийш эргэнэ үү» (24/30), up to 3 lines, never truncated. Font scale capped at 1.3 (like all guidance overlay text); stacked banner layout from an effective factor of 1.15

nav-street.$description: NAV-005 banner street name line (one line, ellipsis) and recalculating secondary line (18/24). Font scale capped at 1.3

gutter.$description: Side gutter at every width (phone 16px, desktop 16px)

touch-target.$description: Minimum hit area of every control (principle: 48dp; NAV-002 AC 49 requires >= 44 CSS px)

search-width.$description: NAV-003: max width of the search field, results list and place card at widths >= 600px (compact: full width minus gutters)

list-row-min.$description: NAV-003: min height of a result option and of a state row in the results list

pin-width.$description: NAV-003 pin, incl. stroke. Anchor = bottom tip

side-panel.$description: NAV-004: width of the left grid column that holds the route panel at widths >= breakpoint.expanded (gutter + search-width + gutter). NAV-002 rows move to the second column, so nothing can overlap the panel

route-sheet-max.$description: NAV-004: max height of the route panel as a bottom sheet below breakpoint.expanded; the grid row can shrink it further, the panel scrolls inside

origin-marker.$description: NAV-004 origin marker diameter incl. the 4px ring (same size as the location dot)

switch-width.$description: NAV-004 avoid-unpaved switch track (Material 3 switch); the whole 48px row is the hit area

nav-banner-icon.$description: NAV-005 manoeuvre icon in the guidance banner (dp on Android)

nav-banner-margin.$description: NAV-005 side margin of the banner and the trip progress panel (narrower than the 16dp gutter so the instruction gets the width)

nav-banner-min.$description: NAV-005 minimum banner height (one instruction line)

nav-then-height.$description: NAV-005 Then strip («Дараа нь») and the reserved NAV-013 lane strip

nav-puck.$description: NAV-005 navigation puck (chevron) incl. its 3dp ring, map-style.md §7.4

nav-control-pair.$description: NAV-005 voice + orientation buttons side by side (2 x 48dp + 8dp) at the bottom-right of the map band; the recenter button's max width leaves room for it

nav-map-band-min.$description: NAV-005 minimum portrait map height between the top UI (banner, Then strip, status messages) and the voice notice / progress panel at 360x640 and larger, font scale 100%. At 130-200% the minimum is 80dp; while the voice notice shows, 80dp at 100% and 64dp above (screen spec Layout rule 4)

attribution-strip.$description: NAV-005 Android attribution strip minimum height (its own region, never covered, AC 2)

medium.$description: NAV-003: from this width the search field and the top-bar buttons share one row (Material 3 window class 'medium')

expanded.$description: NAV-003: from this width the place card sits in the left search panel instead of the bottom row (Material 3 'expanded'). Must stay > 2 x (gutter + search-width) = 832px so a pin at the viewport centre is never under the panel

duration-medium.$description: Reset bearing, theme cross-fade of UI chrome

loading-delay.$description: Loading indicator appears only after this delay (NAV-002 AC 37, NAV-003 AC 13 and 27)

search-debounce.$description: NAV-003 AC 3: search starts this long after the last keystroke (allowed 200-350ms)

long-press.$description: NAV-003 AC 25: touch long-press that opens a coordinate card (max 10px movement)

route-mode-settle.$description: NAV-004 AC 11: a mode tab must stay selected this long before the route request is sent

route-eta-refresh.$description: NAV-004 AC 25: «Хүрэх цаг» is recomputed from the clock at this interval (+-5 s), no request, not announced

route-camera.$description: NAV-004 AC 17 and AC 30: route fitBounds on the first render of a response and easeTo on a turn-row activation. AC 17/30 allow 1 s from render to arrival; the shared duration-camera (1000 ms) measured 1025-1296 ms in the app, so this budget is 1000 ms minus about 300 ms for render-to-first-frame overhead. Route preview only: NAV-002/NAV-003 keep duration-camera. prefers-reduced-motion: 0ms (jump, done within 500 ms)

nav-camera-follow.$description: NAV-005 AC 23: the follow camera reaches each new position and bearing within this time (linear easing between fixes at 1 Hz). Reduced motion: jump

nav-recenter-timeout.$description: NAV-005 AC 25: following resumes after this long without a map gesture (story default, confirmed by UX)

nav-recenter-show.$description: NAV-005 AC 25: «Байршил руу буцах» appears within this time after a map gesture

nav-voice-notice.$description: NAV-005 AC 39: the no-Mongolian-voice notice (glossary A1) stays this long (AC: >= 5 s), or until tapped

nav-gps-restored.$description: NAV-005 AC 52: «GPS дохио сэргэлээ» stays this long

nav-gps-lost-after.$description: NAV-005 AC 51: no good fix for this long = GPS lost

nav-prompt-max-delay.$description: NAV-005 AC 34: a voice prompt that cannot start within this time of its trigger is dropped

nav-prompt-repeat-gap.$description: NAV-005 navigation-ux.md §4.2 rule 2: a prompt is skipped if another prompt for the same manoeuvre started less than this long ago

nav-chime.$description: NAV-005 D23 fallback chime: 880 Hz 120 ms, 20 ms gap, 1320 Hz 180 ms, 10 ms fades (navigation-ux.md §4.8); AC 39 allows <= 1 s

nav-resumed-notice.$description: NAV-012 AC 18: «Замчлал сэргэлээ» (glossary B3) stays this long in the status area after a restore (navigation-ux.md §12.4)

theme-auto-hold.$description: NAV-012 AC 42: «Автомат» makes at most one automatic theme change in this window, so a sunrise/sunset boundary that moves with the position cannot flicker (navigation-ux.md §12.7)
